message: include in pnpm-workspace.yaml gives minimumReleaseAge and permissions to the config dependency @acme/pnpm-policy, whose settings depcurfew cannot read, so it cannot verify these settings, and depcurfew apply does not write them
fix: Take minimumReleaseAge and permissions out of the list of @acme/pnpm-policy in include, so that depcurfew apply writes them into pnpm-workspace.yaml and depcurfew doctor checks them; or check the pnpm.config file of @acme/pnpm-policy by hand against depcurfew.json
